chapter: Joe Liggins and back to Kid Ory
title: Rejoining Kid Ory, 1948 to 1953
summary: Ory called Joe back as if nothing had happened; he stayed from 1948-49 until he was fired in 1953, recording for Columbia and Victor.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: Well, after that, I came back to Los Angeles here and went back with Ory. See, now I'm talking about 1948 or '49.
That was when Blakeney was with the band.
That's right. When Papa Mutt had left the band.
Papa Mutt left in I think '45 or '46, didn't he?
That's right. And I stayed with Ory up until 1953.
Oh, a great long time. That's five years or something.
You see? I stayed with him a long time after that. Anyway, that's when we recorded a lot more. We recorded for Columbia, Victor and whatever....
Did Ory ask you to come back there?

Yeah. After I left... Like I said, I came back to Seattle after Joe Liggins, and Ory sent for me and called me. Because he was... He had worked some kind of recording session or something, or some kind of a special deal, I think, for the Armed Forces -- I can't think of what it was. I don't know if it was a record for public release.
You mean that he called you about making?
Yeah. And he says, 'Well, do you want...' -- as if nothing had happened. I says, 'Well, I ain't doin' too much here anyway.' So I came on back down here.
And you stayed all that while with him.
Yeah, I stayed with him until '53, then got fired.
